attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false; no dracut rebuild needed since usb-storage is not present in the initramfs). Verified the module cannot load immediately, restarted node1 with shutdown -r now, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified post-reboot that the config persisted and the module remains blocked.
